Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production pixel-art character action atlas for Chinese wuxia ARPG. Input image is the already-approved Xiepai youth, it is the immutable identity, clothes, palette, coarse pixel style and proportion reference. Create new character skill poses of this SAME young man, same plain cloth headband/topknot, ink-black split longcoat with dark-purple lapels/waist and tiny poison-green edging, brown-black trousers/shoes, normal small face, one Chinese broadback thinblade dao. For these palm-casting skills the single dao is secured diagonally to the back to free both hands: short wrapped hilt and small blade projection only, no long pole or second weapon. No new outfit or face.
Style: the same low-resolution 16-bit chunky pixel clusters as reference; NOT high resolution illustration, use about 40-41 actual pixels tall character before integer enlargement. 45-degree orthographic 3/4 top-down camera, upper-left hard light, 2-shade materials, 1-pixel own dark material outline. ONLY the reference's 16 colors: browns for head/skin, black/purple coat, tiny green edges and muted silver blade. Transparent background (real alpha), no ground shadow, no checker pattern, no labels or grid lines. NO detached effect, poison clouds, beam, symbols, glow, particles or duplicated afterimages: separate effect assets will be added by game.
Composition: exactly THREE rows and SIX equal columns on a wide 1536x1024 transparent canvas. Each pose fully isolated with generous blank gaps, same scale, baseline within each row, fixed root between feet, limbs and weapon all fit roughly 44x60 native box. Empty cells truly empty. Do not crop or overlap figures. All poses grounded with two feet near a common footline, no lunging root translation.
ROW 1: exactly FOUR left-to-right dushazhang poison-sand-palm poses, last two cells empty. 0 draw casting hand toward waist in compact low stance, 1 thrust open palm forward at chest height, 2 follow-through outward flick/scatter gesture with fingers (no sand drawn), 3 retract to guard. Distinct silhouettes and convincing movement.
ROW 2: exactly FIVE left-to-right huagongsan poison-powder throw poses, sixth empty. 0 take a tiny folded pouch from waist, elbow bent; 1 hold tiny pouch at shoulder ready to throw, bent elbow, a stable aiming pose to be held; 2 extend arm and toss toward target; 3 extended open empty hand following the throw (pouch no longer in hand; no flying projectile), 4 retract to guard. The pouch is tiny muted brown-purple, not a green orb, no magic FX.
ROW 3: exactly SIX left-to-right shehunshu soul-binding casting poses. 0 both hands at lower chest, 1 hands lift slightly and elbows open, 2 hands open at chest, 3 hands curl inward, forms a small breathing casting cycle 0-3 without moving feet or head much. 4 release: reach open palm forward with compact bent shoulder, 5 lower hand in recovery. No beam or glow, only character. Ensure all 15 poses are visibly different but preserve body scale.
DIRECTION IN EVERY CELL: toward viewer/down-screen, reference face visible; palm throws come toward camera with strong foreshortening, not to screen left or right. Keep direction, scale and fixed foot root in ALL 15 poses.
